title: Restricted Funds created, released, or executed

restricted_funds_id.title: Restricted Funds identifier
restricted_funds_id.description: A unique identifier for the restricted funds.

external_account_id.title: External Account identifier
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization.

hold_method.title: Hold Method
hold_method.description: Defines how the balance hold should be applied. STRICT: fully blocks the requested amount. FLEXIBLE: only blocks the available balance. RECURRENT: allows the held amount to be increased over time, up to increase_datetime_limit, for recurring restriction use cases.

type.title: Restricted Funds Type
type.description: Defines the type of restriction applied to the funds. REGULATORY: a regulatory-driven restriction. JUDICIAL: a restriction resulting from a judicial block order.

increase_datetime_limit.title: Increase Datetime Limit
increase_datetime_limit.description: For RECURRENT hold method restrictions, the datetime limit until which the held amount may be automatically increased, in ISO 8601 format.

release_datetime.title: Release Datetime
release_datetime.description: Scheduled date for the automatic release of the remaining restricted funds balance, in ISO 8601 format.

requested_amount.title: Requested Amount
requested_amount.description: The amount requested at the time of creating the funds restriction

held_amount.title: Held Amount
held_amount.description: The actual amount currently held. This value may be less than the requested_amount when the hold_method is FLEXIBLE, or when part of the held balance has already been released.

soft_descriptor.title: Soft Descriptor
soft_descriptor.description: A short description provided by the client for the funds restriction.

metadata.title: Key-value fields that contain any related data your organization needs to store at Pismo. Maximum size: 1 KB when serialized to JSON.

operations.description: List of related operations for this funds restriction.

type.title: Operation Type
type.description: Type of the operation related to this funds restriction.

processing_code.title: Processing Code
processing_code.description: Processing code used to create the underlying restriction. Each operation type uses a default processing code.

requested_amount.title: Requested Amount
requested_amount.description: The amount requested specifically for this operation.

applied_amount.title: Applied Amount
applied_amount.description: The exact amount applied in this operation. It may be less than the requested_amount only if the hold_method is FLEXIBLE and the available balance is lower than requested_amount.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this operation was created, in ISO 8601 format.

applied_at.title: Applied At
applied_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this operation was actually applied, in ISO 8601 format.

soft_descriptor.title: Soft Descriptor
soft_descriptor.description: A short description provided by the client for the funds restriction.

metadata.title: Key-value fields that contain any related data your organization needs to store at Pismo. Maximum size: 1 KB when serialized to JSON.
